title: Patch: Immutable stops stat buffs, debuffs, keyword grants and auras from other cards
notes: Issue #5113 (R5113000): Immutable keeps every change another card makes to a card's stats or keywords off it, in every zone, an Indestructible Unit card's included (R4353000): a buff or debuff, for good or this turn (buff, buffAllUnits, buffCards, buffRandomUnit, doubleStats, buffThisTurn), a set Attack this turn (amending R4591000), a keyword given (grantKeyword, grantRandomKeywords with no draw, grantKeywordCards, a draw's or a summon's keywords), another card's aura (stats, keywords, set Attack), a combat-only Attack bonus (R1120) and its controller's "your Units have" lends. Its own text still changes it (R23). Reported from a practice game where S #15 Arg Arg Defender gave S #116 Megabase +1/+1 and Taunt. R5113001: S+ #46 Phase Fabric gives its keywords with one grantKeywords, so its own Immutable does not turn the rest away; an Immutable target takes none.

player.title: Immutable Units can't be buffed or nerfed
changes: Immutable now also stops other cards from changing a card's Attack, Health or keywords.
Buffs and debuffs, ones that last a turn included, keywords given to it, auras and "your Units have" effects all pass an Immutable card by.
An Immutable card's own text still changes it, and damage, healing and destroy effects still reach it.
Every Indestructible Unit is Immutable, so the same holds for it.
Phase Fabric still gives all of its keywords, but gives none to a Unit that is already Immutable.
fixes: Arg Arg Defender no longer gives an Immutable neighbour such as Megabase +1/+1 and Taunt.
